    4.  Tone: Professional, utility-focused.
    5.  No AI Slop: Avoid "enhanced", "streamlined", "seamless", "robust".
    6.  No Exclamation Points: Only periods.
    7.  No dev-time bugs: For new features (N/A).
    8.  True Bug Fixes: Start with "Fixed a bug if [Condition], [Symptom]".
    9.  Output: JUST the summary text.

    *   Issue: `billToPartyId` is null on `OrderHeader` when an *existing* customer places an order.
